currentParagraphText: Lifting his hand, a lantern appeared in it. Without any huge fanfare, he channeled energy into it and out came... something. It was wrapped in energy for a brief moment as it exited, but this energy soon dispersed naturally.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: Lifting his hand, a lantern appeared in it. Without any huge fanfare, he channeled energy into it and out came... something. It was wrapped in energy for a brief moment as it exited, but this energy soon dispersed naturally.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: Jake intuitively knew it was the end. Without the protection of Jacob, the Truesoul of Ell’Hakan, the Celestial Child, disappeared and returned to the system where it belonged. With that, the Bloodline was gone from the multiverse, and Jake felt a wave of relief knowing it was finally all over.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: The Augur sighed loudly as he looked toward the sky a moment before speaking again. “I guess there is still one important thing left to do.”
